scope: P0.1 isolated development verification, not production acceptance

results.detail: Live public company URL fetched; timestamp, excerpt and content hash persisted (verification example, not a HANA customer).
Actual server run loaded the versioned sales-marketing resource and persisted its matching SHA-256.
Same request replays one run; a new request for the same owner/domain retains one opportunity.
Three simultaneous API requests claim exactly one run and one attempt.
Missing source returns blocked/source_unavailable; manual text remains unverified and cannot qualify or override workflow.
Real JWT/RLS isolates owners, rejects editable-metadata escalation, direct privileged RPC and Church business requests.
Existing hana_reviews stores actual internal approval; approval never marks contacted or sends a message.
Real Supabase password re-login reads the same persisted PostgreSQL opportunity; browser reload/re-login tested separately.
A real public HTTP request with a 1ms deadline records timeout; explicit retry succeeds in the same run with preserved attempt history.
Actual persisted opportunities and source-backed rules drafts export correctly; formula cells escaped, no send path called.
